about.description: I'm a front-end developer, and I've been working with React and TypeScript for {{years}}+ years. At Fida Solutions I build applications for public institutions: interactive maps, multi-step forms and interfaces that have to work for everyone. I like to understand the problem before I write any code, and to leave behind a codebase the next person on the team can read easily.

mapDemo.title: Public services in Maramureș
mapDemo.intro: I was born and raised in Maramureș, so I picked my home county for this demo. It's an interactive map of public institutions, the kind of GIS interface I build every day for the public sector: filters, search, a list kept in sync with the map, and the nearest institution with a route to it.
mapDemo.disclaimer: A small demo built for this portfolio with public OpenStreetMap data. It isn't a real product and uses nothing from the projects I work on; some institutions may be missing or incomplete.
mapDemo.hint: Click anywhere on the map or use your location to find the nearest institution.

invitatio.summary: A free wedding planner in Romanian, for couples who organize their own wedding.
invitatio.role: Product, design, front-end and back-end, on my own
invitatio.problem: Couples keep the guest list, the budget and the seating plan in separate spreadsheets and in messages to each other. I wanted one place for all of it, free and built around Romanian weddings.
built: Both partners work on the same data from separate accounts, with live sync.
A drag-and-drop seating plan with round and rectangular tables.
Public pages are prerendered for Google, while the planner itself is an SPA behind login.
My own back-end: a Hono API with Drizzle and PostgreSQL on Neon, running serverless on Vercel, plus a daily job and transactional emails.
invitatio.result: It's live at invitatio.ro, free for anyone, and I maintain it on my own, from the code to the infrastructure.

vanillaCleaning.summary: A website for a carpet cleaning business in Cluj-Napoca.
vanillaCleaning.role: Design, code and SEO, on my own
vanillaCleaning.problem: The business needed to show up on Google for people in Cluj looking for carpet cleaning, not just for people who already had its phone number.
built: A React site with prerendered pages, so search engines see the full content.
Pages and blog posts editable in TinaCMS, so content changes don't have to go through me.
A mobile-first design with call and WhatsApp buttons always within reach.
vanillaCleaning.result: Over the last year, about 40% of visitors came from Google search.
